calibration.calibration_note: Benchmark size (N=9) demonstrates evidence-quality discrimination but is insufficient for statistical probability calibration. System confidence scores must NOT be marketed as empirical probabilities.

case_results.title: Case 1 — Strongly Supported
reasons: 3 valid supporting evidence events cited across 3 distinct source type(s) (alert, deployment, metric).
Temporal sequence is compatible: alleged trigger preceded observed symptoms.
No contradicting evidence cited.
Temporal correlation alone does not establish causation; sequence is not causal proof.

case_results.title: Case 2 — Weak Correlation / Unsupported Mechanism
reasons: 2 valid supporting evidence events cited across 2 distinct source type(s) (alert, deployment).
Temporal sequence is compatible: alleged trigger preceded observed symptoms.
No contradicting evidence cited.
Asserts failure mechanism (database_connection_pool) without corroborating evidence in cited telemetry.
Temporal correlation alone does not establish causation; sequence is not causal proof.

case_results.title: Case 3 — Meaningful Contradiction
reasons: 1 valid supporting evidence events cited across 1 distinct source type(s) (deployment).
Temporal order is chronologically compatible with recorded evidence.
1 contradicting evidence event(s) cited against this hypothesis.
Temporal correlation alone does not establish causation; sequence is not causal proof.

case_results.title: Case 4 — Invalid Citation / Nonexistent Evidence
reasons: Hypothesis cited zero valid supporting evidence events for this incident.
Cited 1 reference(s) that could not be resolved to valid incident evidence.
Invalid or ungrounded citations receive zero grounding credit.
